description: This source file implements a sample application demonstrating the use of the GL_OVR_multiview2 extension in OpenGL ES. It sets up multiview rendering with layered textures, renders multiple cubes from different perspectives, and combines the views into a single display output.

classes.name: MultiviewSample
classes.description: A class inheriting from SampleApplication that manages the setup, rendering, and cleanup of a multiview OpenGL ES sample demonstrating layered rendering and view combination.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL resources, compiles shaders, sets up textures, framebuffers, and geometry for the multiview rendering.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up OpenGL resources such as shaders, textures, buffers, and framebuffers.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering: renders multiple views to a layered framebuffer, then combines and displays the result.
